details:
Okay, so this started awhile back like... last year? Year and a half? But its happened multiple times and is not limited to simply random people in an instance.

It started with a rando when I checked to read their bio but had to rush to the bathroom. I didn't think to close the profile menu before I went and simply took off the headset. I figured it would be fine but when I came back, I had accidently friended the person I was reading the bio of.

I had quickly unfriended them and moved on, but later, it happened with someone I blocked. I went to check their profile real quick(Which I do sometimes either from something as simple as checking a NOTE made on it if someone asks why they were blocked so I can remember. To checking groups of someone I really don't wanna be around, just to be sure I don't end up joining an instance they are in.) and when I exited(Again, a blocked person, so no way to accidently hit the button to friend them.), I realized moments after they were friended again. Which gave me a panic attack.

This happened TWO MORE TIMES and now a friend of mine is also having this issue.

Please fix this... otherwise I can't even feel safe checking notes or doing anything I normally do to be cautious, out of risk of friending someone I don't want around me...

Honestly, I worry it will happen just looking at bios in general...

Seriously, please tell the cat I can handle friending people on my own.
title: VRChat Auto-Requesting Friends
